title: heare Phase B-polish — Less water, fewer double-turns
notes: User observation: agent produces 2-4 TTS frames per turn with filler, polite hedging, promise-then-execute-then-describe, unsolicited alternatives. Also: Groq STT split one utterance into two transcriptions ('Але повідомлення зберігаються…' + 'подивитися, які там є'), causing duplicate agent replies. Two fixes in one cycle: tighten prompt, debounce TranscriptionFrame arrivals inside GeneratorProcessor.

stories.title: Anti-water prompt constraints
stories.description: Rewrite the 'Правила відповіді' block in prompts/generator.txt to enforce one-sentence, <=12-word replies; ban thank-you/apology/unsolicited-alternative fillers; cap pre-intent text to 5 words; ban permission questions after a direct command. Keep the existing INTENTS block (Phase B) unchanged.

prompts/generator.txt contains a rule limiting pre-intent wording to a short phrase (name 'коротко', 'до 5 слів', or equivalent).
prompts/generator.txt contains a rule prohibiting permission questions when the user already gave a direct command.

stories.title: Debounce TranscriptionFrame arrivals
stories.description: Groq STT occasionally emits two TranscriptionFrames for what a human would call one utterance (mid-sentence pause). The Generator currently processes each as a separate turn, producing duplicate replies. Add a short debounce window inside GeneratorProcessor: buffer incoming transcript text and process as one turn after N ms of silence. Configurable via Settings.transcript_debounce_seconds (default 0.6).
acceptanceCriteria: src/config.py Settings gains a transcript_debounce_seconds: float attribute defaulting to 0.6 seconds. 0 disables debouncing (legacy behavior).

src/generator.py GeneratorProcessor buffers TranscriptionFrames: on arrival it appends text to a per-processor buffer, cancels any pending debounce task, and schedules a new task that will call the existing _handle_transcription path with the combined text after transcript_debounce_seconds seconds.

When the debounce window fires, the combined text is passed to _handle_transcription along with the latest frame's speaker_id / speaker_confidence. Multiple transcript fragments are joined with a single space.
When transcript_debounce_seconds == 0, _handle_transcription is invoked inline (no debouncing) — preserves existing single-frame-per-turn behavior for tests.
New unit test: two TranscriptionFrames arriving 300 ms apart produce exactly ONE _handle_transcription invocation with combined text. Use monkeypatched asyncio.sleep or short real debounce value.
New unit test: a single TranscriptionFrame followed by silence produces exactly ONE _handle_transcription invocation with that frame's text.
New unit test: transcript_debounce_seconds=0 produces immediate per-frame processing (regression coverage for the inline path).

Existing test_generator.py tests — which pass transcript_debounce_seconds=0 via Settings or rely on the current immediate dispatch — still pass. If any test needs adjustment, the adjustment is narrow and documented in the test's docstring.
